title: Engine diet: port the 10 KJNodes we use into MpiNodes
description: ColorMatch, GetImageRangeFromBatch, GrowMaskWithBlur, ImageBatchExtendWithOverlap, ImageBatchMulti, ImageResizeKJv2, LTX2_NAG, LTXVAudioVideoMask, LoraExtractKJ, VAELoaderKJ. Drops color-matcher, mss, matplotlib, opencv. Weigh first: KJ often ships LTX fixes early (LTX2_NAG, VAELoaderKJ), so the LTX nodes may be worth keeping on the pack. Part of the Engine diet umbrella.
